name: Lija Court Compression Arm Sleeve
description: The Lija Court Compression Arm Sleeve applies graduated compression from wrist to bicep to support the forearm during long sessions, a popular choice for players managing tennis elbow. A silicone gripper band keeps it in place, and the fabric is rated UPF 30.
care_instructions: Hand wash or machine wash cold in a mesh bag. Lay flat to dry; do not tumble dry, which weakens the compression fibers.
